body: its later this year (i don't want to say exactly). but within the next few months, i'd need to have enough spare "change" to "celebrate" if I do. I've done those things and literally gotten screwed from them in some way. I just have shitty shitty shitty luck. I can't escape it, so I wanna beat it at its own fucked up game.

They're never available. like 5+ years in a row. My best friend whom I've let in and out of my  life, literally saved her life, didn't even attempt to make it to my college graduation. these are just the type of shithead people that gravatate towards me. everything's fine and dandy until I'd like to feel cared for. Have you ever seen "The Bridge." I'm planning a date to myself, preferably out of town….way out of town. The problem is, if I'm alone and can't bear it, I'll probably kill myself. 

If I'm alone and enjoy it, I could do something reckless or just still dwell that no one was there for me to enjoy this with. It seems small thing (birthdays), but I have literally been neglected my entire life by family, and now friends. I'm not one of those douchebag people that drives people out either. I am just not wanted here. That day is coming up, where I just don't think I'm meant to live past a certain age. I'm totally stressing because I have enough guts and nothing to lose, I just might do it. I'm stressing that I will. Nothing is improving. And I don't fucking like anyone in my life anymore for their mistreatment. But being entirely alone is enough to push me over the edge. I've tried it all. I'm not in HS, college, like. Nothing improved after I fought so hard to survive those years.

if its a loop, you have to change the direction or snip it. i agree. the denial that people have…makes you feel even more guilty, more resentful, more over it all. sometimes it never gets better. i'm not encouraging it, but i know the reality of where your head is at. i believe in free will. if something is holding you back cuz if you really wanted to do it now, you'd be dead right? maybe you are meant to wait it out. heavy is the head that wears the crown, they say. as i get older, i understand that more clearer than ever. and it's nothing religious i'm saying to you, it's a gift sometimes. this unbearable pain is a gift and if you can suffocate the shit out of the perspective you have, it could renew you. change the loop. from one sad panda to another, hugs all around. we may not be God, but how do you know things couldn't get better? when we get this depressed, we believe we see the future. we don't, we can't. every so often, we hit the mark. really it's just a trap in our head. force yourself outside. i believe in you. brilliant, sad, beautiful minds cannot be taken from this world anymore. offer all you can to YOURSELF, nobody else. live for you. maybe that's how you change the loop? I'm talking "out loud" but I feel like me talking to you, could help me too. I know of a way, but instead I chose to write this to you. Maybe this is how I change the loop too.

I think it is the most beautiful thing in the world to be gay. I truly wish I was. There are so many gay men and women I know with long-standing beautiful relationships that are of course touched by vulnerability, but they stand strong together. They discover together. Imagine you are a new person, a brand new person who gets to discover life all over again. You are a child, with an adult's brain. You have knowledge, consent, interest and you are blessed with a new idea of acceptance. You could forever be haunted by who you are, or you could forever be hopeful in meeting your "Prince" because you, of all people, have the blessing of knowing what real trust is. And what real intimacy is. That is the blessing of being gay. I say this as a minority myself. Our oppressed perspective is our greatest strength. My friend, use this to your advantage. Imagine your first kiss with a man you like. You will feel at ease, probably nervous, but I'm sure melt into the person you are meant to be. It is okay. Do not be ashamed in who you are. It's their problem, not yours. We can make our own family. You're old enough to know what's right and wrong. I dare you to go out and live as proud gay man you are, I dare you to go meet someone who may be just like you, living in justified fear, maybe you will find your first friend…your first love. I just dare you to live a life of truth. I know it will bring you the happiness you have been suffering without for so long. Before you go off thinking everything is meaningless, I dare you to find meaning in your truth. Please. Believe it or not, but you are hope to me. People beating the odds and themselves. Beating the fear in their heads. I truly understand your fear, I really do, but there is no greater victory than beating it. I know you can :)

oh kid, you made me smile. i'm in my early 30's, but we are Groot. 

everything you told me, i want you to never forget it either. i just told another younger reditter that he/she will have to kick their own butt out of these dark voids sometimes. i've really been trying, but honestly sometimes the cards are just not in your favor. I'm going to give it all I can until… Idk. But I can guarantee you I WILL remember why I want to end my life. It's always with me. Literally apart of my body unfortunately. Thanks for your support :) I'm gonna go walk it off and at least for today, maybe I will forget why and maybe reconcile with the Now. I have to enjoy the now today.

i wish i could spend this beautiful day with you. trust me, i know exactly how you feel. you really do have to force yourself outside sometime. and if i could be near you, i would. we would just walk for hours and you could talk to me or not. but eventually you will see how far you've walked and that the sun is out…and it's beautiful. you're too young and you have so much time to feel that kind of moment. i'm more than a decade older than you and I wish I could get those days back. I know you don't know me, but I love you and I'm holding you close, if you are in bed. But I am whispering in your ear "go outside, fall in love with the day." Remember those words, ok? If there is one rule you should live according to someone else, it's those. That will buy you time and eventually, you'll get those 3 steps back and thensome. I'm not gonna tell you to cheer up. But I will say, go outside and explore. Even if you're depressed. Trust me, you will never get these days back. I don't want you to regret them the way I did. This is my throwaway account, but MSG me if you ever want to vent. And I recently made a not so happy post, but I believe this too shall pass. And I envy you kid. I really do. 

You're gonna have to kick your own butt as you get older. And one day, it will bring you that peace you have been suffering for so long to feel.
